prompt:
Rewrite snippets/membership-renewal-timeline.liquid. It renders a member's renewal history as a timeline with special handling for the first and last entries. Inputs (all top-level variables, there is no section object): - `member_name`: string or null. It may have surrounding whitespace and may contain < > & ". - `renewals`: array or null, ordered oldest first. Each element always has both keys: - `period`: string, never null. It may contain < > & and must be HTML-escaped. - `amount`: non-negative integer, never null. It is a whole-dollar amount. Heading H: - Strip `member_name`. If the result is non-empty, H is `Renewal history for NAME`, where NAME is the stripped name HTML-escaped with `escape`. - Otherwise (null, empty or only whitespace), H is `Renewal history`. Output, with no whitespace or newlines between or inside tags: - If `renewals` is null or empty, output exactly: `

H

No renewals yet.

` - Otherwise, output: `

H

    ITEMS

Total paid: $TOTAL

` - TOTAL is the sum of all amounts. Each renewal produces `
  • PERIODLABEL$AMOUNTDELTA
    • `. CLASSES always starts with `renewal`. Then: - append ` renewal--first` for the first entry; - append ` renewal--current` for the last entry. - A single entry gets both, in that order: `renewal renewal--first renewal--current`. LABEL: - `Joined (current)` if the entry is both first and last; - else `Joined` for the first entry; - else `Current` for the last entry; - else `Renewed`. DELTA: - The first entry has no DELTA (nothing output). - Every other entry outputs `X`. Let D = this amount minus the amount of the immediately preceding entry. X is: - `+D` when D > 0 (e.g. `+5`); - D with its minus sign when D < 0 (e.g. `-10`); - `=` when D is 0. Output only the specified elements/attributes; escape dynamic text and attributes. Inter-element whitespace, comments and quote style may vary; leaf text is exact. Change only snippets/membership-renewal-timeline.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
